description: This file defines the Bootstrap modal component, including the Modal class, its methods for showing, hiding, and managing modal dialogs, and the jQuery plugin interface for Bootstrap modals.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: A class representing the modal dialog component, with methods to show, hide, toggle, and manage modal behavior.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the modal.

methods.name: enforceFocus
methods.description: Ensures focus stays within the modal when it is open.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Handles escape key press to close the modal if enabled.

methods.name: hideModal
methods.description: Performs actions to hide the modal and trigger related events.

methods.name: backdrop
methods.description: Creates or removes the modal backdrop with optional callback.

methods.name: checkScrollbar
methods.description: Checks if scrollbar is present and measures its width.

methods.name: setScrollbar
methods.description: Adjusts body padding to account for scrollbar width.

methods.name: measureScrollbar
methods.description: Measures the width of the scrollbar.
